data.one_liner: Generate random User-Agent strings for Dart/Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: This library provides a simple API to generate random User-Agent headers. It can be used directly or with a custom filter function to narrow results.
use_when: Need to spoof or randomize User-Agent in HTTP requests
Testing network requests with varied headers
Avoiding bot detection in web scraping
avoid_when: Need to parse or validate existing User-Agent strings
weaknesses: Only generates strings, no HTTP integration
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec and import package
